description: Definitions no Strapi ref reaches: methods, content-types, components, services, policies, middlewares. Only Strapi refs count, so a method called directly in TS still appears — verify before deleting. `onlyArchivedCallers`: only called by migrations Strapi never runs; `requiredByPath`: its file is loaded by path, so the module is used.

file.description: Only this file, absolute or relative to the project root (default: the whole app).

from.description: A path inside the project (the file you are editing; relative to its root with `project`), in a multi-project workspace.

project.description: A project name or root, when no path is at hand.

name: list_unused
title: Find unused Strapi entities/methods
